name: @vibase/approvals-app
description: The approvals mini-app: a static page (Cloudflare Workers Static Assets, no server code) that lists pending action requests of one Vibase and approves or rejects them. Signs in with Clerk, calls Vibase from the browser through @vibase/sdk.

scripts.deploy:remote: pnpm build && CONFIRM_REMOTE=1 wrangler deploy --env hq
